name: s6_second_decoder
title: A second decoder recovers the state from Oracle Lens's readouts; the NLA's are separable only by a probe fit on their own rebuilds
caption: Exp 24: each readout (k = 1, exp 20's) is fed to Oracle Lens's own activation reconstructor (trained on text spans, layer tag 44), 160 items per row. Left: a probe fit on the rebuilds of the true 32-token span, applied frozen: Oracle Lens's readouts reach 0.73 to 0.80 on five of six readable rows (call argument 0.61); the NLA's explanations sit at chance. Right: a probe fit by grouped 5-fold CV on each readout's own rebuilds: the NLA's explanations separate at 0.81 to 0.90. Bars: Hanley-McNeil 95% (no per-item scores saved; ignores clustering).
